note: The controlling typical edition and the derived digital comparison differ substantively: the page prints the apposition Unigéniti tui Matris and the conclusion Per eúndem, which the digital source omits. Accidental differences are recorded separately.

adjudicated.ruling: The 1962 typical edition (p. 701) prints the apposition Unigéniti tui Matris; the pinned digital proper omits it. The complete selected phrase is positively attested in the controlling composite witness.

The 1962 typical edition (p. 701) closes with Per eúndem Dóminum because the Son is named in the prayer; the pinned digital proper has Per Dóminum. The complete selected phrase is positively attested in the controlling composite witness.
